title: black bean meatballs
ingredients: 1 can black beans; drained and rinsed
1/2 cup breadcrumbs; sourdough (see notes) or panko
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cook black beans in microwave for 1 minute. Add to a large bowl and lightly mash with a potato masher.
Add egg, ketchup, nutritional yeast, oregano, garlic powder, thyme, Worcestershire sauce, onion, and a pinch of salt. Stir until combined.
Start with about 75% of the breadcrumbs, adding more as needed until the texture is something like a dough.
Roll into about 10 balls, about 1.5 Tbsp each, and place on the prepared baking sheet. Anywhere from 9–12 balls works comfortably.
Bake for 23 minutes or until browned on the bottom and firm.
notes:
Sourdough breadcrumbs: Tear 2–3 bread heels into pieces and pulse/blend in a Vitamix until the size of panko. Toss into the unlined baking sheet while preparing the other ingredients and toast for 5–8 minutes, stirring halfway through. Wipe out pan, add parchment and reuse it for cooking the meatballs.

Try tomato paste instead of ketchup. Also try adding other spices like sage, marjoram, or fennel.
